correctness.rationale: From Baruah–Gogoi Theorem 1.1, 8sum D q^n=f2/f1-f1^7/f2^3. Since f2/f1=sum Q q^n, the correction is eta(24z)^7/eta(48z)^(-3) after q->exp(2pi i24z). Weight (7-3)/2=2; eta congruence sums 24,264 divisible by 24; exponent character 2^9 3^4 gives chi8. For all c|1152, gcd(c,48)/gcd(c,24) is 1 or 2, yielding strictly positive cusp orders (independently checked 24 divisors, min 1, max 11). The fixed-level weight-2 cusp coefficient bound O_epsilon(m^(1/2+epsilon)) follows from newform decomposition and Deligne; Q(n) has exponential asymptotic. Independently recomputed coefficients through n=80 with a distinct-part weight DP and separate logarithmic derivative; all matched. Finite checks are not the proof.
